sections.content: Godin says ChatGPT has a poor reputation with him because it regularly overpromises and underdelivers, and does so without kindness or humility. He describes Claude as having a brand, while ChatGPT is merely a tool he uses when he has no other options.

sections.heading: Why he pays more
sections.content: He is willing to pay extra for Claude because he values that brand and the experience of kindness, humility, and clear limits. His willingness to pay reflects loyalty to Claude, rather than simply choosing whichever tool is available.
